lines: This is the Apex Insurance ladder — for licensed life-insurance agents.
Here you're paid a commission on the first-year premium of every policy you write.
Your commission rate rises with your rank — from fifty percent, all the way up to ninety.
There are seven ranks, from Pre-Associate to M.G.A., each with a higher rate.
You climb by production and by quality — writing consistent, well-placed business.
You're contracted directly with top carriers — so your commissions are paid straight to you.
And the business you write is yours. You own your book — it stays with you as you grow.
Build a team, and you earn overrides on their production, six generations deep.
Here's an example. You recruit five agents, they each build, and your team grows to twenty.
If each writes around five thousand a month in premium, your overrides can reach about seventy-five hundred a month.
Stay consistent, and a weekly production bonus rewards you on top — one to four percent.
Reach M.G.A. and build your own shop, and a quarterly recruiting bonus pays up to six thousand.
That's the Insurance ladder — higher rates as you rank, a book you own, and overrides on your team.
